purpose: Paper 1 (dual-polarization heading + single-anchor EKF): accuracy-first comparison DR / range-only / SWB

routes.N1: corridor loop, start next to anchor (rho 0.6 m)
routes.N2: slalom out (+-0.35 m, 4 m wavelength), straight back
routes.N4: stop-and-look (+-45 deg in-place) out, straight back
routes.N5: far-end start, lane changes (~14 deg), centre-line return

environment: RT Corridor BLOCK_C, anchor B (10, 0, 2.65 m), tag 0.45 m, mount 0 deg; N1-N6 RT and CIR from Snowball run BLOCK_C_M7_N1_N6_20261124_U37mIR8l

arms.H0: DR: wheel + gyro, no RF update
arms.H1S: range-only EKF; mu_r = U3 (HGB on 16 CIR features, sweep-trained, uniform station weights), R_rr = sweep CV mean-square by measured-range rho bin
arms.H2S-SWB: H1S range channel + polarization s with SWB block as observation function h_s = m(x,y,psi); mu_s = 0; R_ss = column-out mean-square by prior-rho bin [0,3),[3,6),[6,10); white G0, 2-D NIS gate 9.21, Joseph

seeds.note: dev used during development (V1 settings chosen on R2/R5 dev); N routes never used for tuning

metrics.rmse: per seed: sqrt(mean over packets); summary: median over 20 seeds, and pooled over all packets of all seeds
metrics.ratio: seed-paired SWB/ref; median and bootstrap 97.5% upper bound (10000 resamples)
metrics.coverage: Pose95 / Heading95 / XY95 = fraction of packets inside nominal 95% region; NEES3 mean
metrics.mirror: branch-metric mirror fail at anchor passages (not meaningful for DR)

source.replay_code: code/run_n1_n6_v1.py (preflight parity <=1e-8 vs R2/R4/R5 V1 runs)
